summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd., an Israeli renewable-energy generator listed on NYSE American and TASE, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release, notice of annual general meeting and proxy statement for its 2026 AGM, to be held December 16, 2026, in Tel Aviv. Agenda items are routine: reelection of four directors and two external directors, approval of external director service terms and option grants, an updated officer/director compensation policy, reappointment of Somekh Chaikin (KPMG) as auditor, and receipt of the FY2025 financial statements. Record date is November 16, 2026; proposals need a simple majority, with special disinterested voting for items 2, 3, 5 and 6. No special-situation event is present.
